title: Practice 6: вз- (вс-): up — на-: onto, and a quantity covered

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: по ней и ___ (взлететь / взлетать — to fly up, to soar, to take off, to take wing) вверх.

exercises.context: взлете́ть** — **взлета́ть — to fly up, to soar, to take off, to take wing; (figurative) to zoom.

exercises.q: И это ___ (наводить / навести — to introduce, bring, produce, make, cause) на него тоску.

exercises.context: навести́** — **наводи́ть — to direct (at), to aim (at), to point (at); to cover, to coat, to apply.

exercises.q: По приказу Зурита в трюм принесли бочку, и матросы ___ (натаскать — to carry or drag) воды.
